savings.rep: The gap between what the hospital pays an agency RN today and the all-in Florence rate, multiplied by their RN need. Say it like this: 'You'd reclaim about ${value} per year without changing a single hour of coverage.'
savings.admin: = (signal_agency_premium_per_hour) × (rn_need_hours) − (florence_fee). Agency rate from HCRIS Worksheet S-3 Part V (or HCRIS fallback per manual-review flag). RN need from HCRIS S-3 Part I worked hours.

deal_score.rep: A 0–100 composite of size, agency premium, contract-labor intensity, and data confidence. Above 70 = lean in. Below 40 = qualify hard or pass. Don't promise the customer this number — it's an internal prioritization signal.
deal_score.admin: 25% size + 20% agency premium + 15% CL intensity + 30% deal score + 10% data confidence (per lead_scoring.florence_fit_score). Computed after RBAC territory filter.

agency_premium.rep: How much MORE the hospital pays for an agency RN than a permanent RN at the same hospital. This is the gap Florence closes. In the field, framed as: 'Today you pay $X/hr for agency; the prevailing permanent wage in your MSA is $Y/hr.'
agency_premium.admin: HCRIS NMRC line 01700 (total contract labor cost) ÷ contract labor hours, minus BLS OEWS MSA mean hourly RN wage. Manual-review flag flips on if HCRIS confidence is low.

contract_labor_intensity.rep: What share of total nursing payroll is going to agencies right now. Higher = more pain = better fit for us. Above 18% is a hot lead.
contract_labor_intensity.admin: HCRIS S-3 Part V contract labor hours ÷ total nursing hours. From most recent fiscal year cost report.

fica_offset.rep: INTERNAL ONLY. Do not say 'FICA' to the customer. The customer-facing story is 'permanent capacity at the cost of agency.' The FICA offset is how WE think about pricing; the customer thinks about savings and capacity.
fica_offset.admin: Per IRC §3121(b)(19), F-1 non-resident-alien wages are FICA-exempt for the first 5 years. Engine targets a 40% offset by default. See pricing_engine.FICA_OFFSET_TARGET mode.

florence_fee.rep: The all-in monthly amount the hospital pays Florence per placed RN. Default is $50K per RN amortized over 36 months ≈ $1,389/month per RN. Excel proposal shows the full schedule.
florence_fee.admin: FLAT_PLACEMENT_FEE mode: $50K × n_rns ÷ 36mo. Locally calibrated by MSA wage + system overlay if configured.

next_best_move.rep: What this rep should do next on this deal, based on the stage. Click the action to log it and advance the stage.
next_best_move.admin: Computed from sales_pipeline.csv stage + last_touched_at. Heuristics live in workbench.next_best_move().
